subject: Cold-depot handoff: signer synchronization & manifest rotation plan
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Reed <daniel.reed@acme-energy.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cold-depot handoff: signer synchronization & manifest rotation plan

Hi Daniel / Acme team,

Following our onsite readiness call, attaching the initial manifest bundle (manifest_v2.1) and a lightweight handoff checklist. Key ask from your side: confirm the operator roster that will perform the physical handoff and whether your courier will require time-windowed access on site (we have a 2-hour provisioning window scheduled Mon 9/20).

High-level approach:
- We deliver signed artifact bundle to your depot (air-gapped courier).
- Depot operator performs signature verification against the signer_roster we provide.
- Operator activates images in a staggered rollout (canary subset of racks first).
- We run a remote attestation handshake (out-of-band) to confirm image hash and signer thumbprints match.

Open items: signer synchronization time (we propose 09/20 10:00 PDT), courier contact, and whether you want a second-signer policy enforced for activation.

Attachments: cold-depot-manifest-v2.1.tar.gz, handoff-checklist.pdf

Thanks,
Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

--

From: Daniel Reed <daniel.reed@acme-energy.com>

Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cold-depot handoff: signer synchronization & manifest rotation plan

Thanks Marcus — quick answers below.

1) Operator roster: Pete Gomez (lead), Alia Santos (backup). I'll attach the operator badge IDs in a separate secure upload.
2) Courier: SecureShip (main). They require a 2-hour arrival window and proof-of-delivery signature.
3) Second-signer policy: yes, we require two local signatures for any activation affecting >25% of racks.

We are OK with the proposed signer sync on 09/20 10:00 PDT; please confirm the signer thumbprint list you will push so we can pre-load verification keys. Also, do you support an operator escrowed manifest (operator receives only the signed manifest and not the private key)?

Daniel
Ops Manager — Acme Energy

Subject: Re: Cold-depot handoff: signer synchronization & manifest rotation plan

Folks — internal checklist / notes before the 09/20 sync: please review and action by EOD 9/16.

1) Signer thumbprints: attached signer_roster_20260914.csv (primary list + rotation table). Karthik, confirm these are the thumbprints we want embedded in the signed manifest.
2) Two-signer policy: we will generate a TD (two-designer) policy in the manifest metadata so Acme's operator client enforces local M-of-N. Marissa, can you add the policy text to the handoff-checklist PDF?
3) Escrowed manifest: yes, we publish a sealed manifest that contains only public keys and per-image hashes; private signing keys remain in our HSM and are never couriered. The courier receives the signed package and signature blobs, not the private key.

Operational notes for the depot operator (this will also go into the Drive folder):
- Validation step 1: verify signature blob against signer roster using sha256sum.
- Validation step 2: compare image hashes against manifest_v2.1/manifest.json (top-level).
- Activation: start with racks 1-4 (canary), monitor heartbeats for 45 minutes, then progressively unlock next batch.

Attachments: signer_roster_20260914.csv

Thanks — Mina
Product Security Lead
Redwood Inference
